legend.title: KDP Guide Lines
legend.subtitle: Canvas Color Codes
legend.bleedDesc: Red dashed line — KDP cutting boundary (0.125" / 3.2 mm)
legend.safeMarginDesc: Indigo dashed line — keep all vital text & faces inside
legend.gutterHingeDesc: Cyan dashed line — spine fold channels & inner binding margin
legend.barcodeDesc: Amber dashed box — reserved ISBN barcode space (2" × 1.2")

aspectRatio.containDesc: Scale by larger dimension, preserves full image (leaves empty borders)
aspectRatio.coverDesc: Scale by smaller dimension, eliminates white bars (activates crop preview)
aspectRatio.previewHint: Drag (pan) the image with mouse to select the ideal crop area
